text: The subject Imran Shafiq holds account PK**HABB****4503 which was opened on 14 December 2023. The subject is declared as a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month. During the activity window from 1 June 2026 to 10 June 2026 the account recorded 20 credits totalling PKR 1,058,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 989,000. All credits arrived via 20 interbank (IBFT) transfers from 14 distinct senders. The activity was flagged by Tazama on 10 June 2026 with a typology score of 360 for MULE-01, exceeding the alert threshold of 300. Overall, the pattern of many distinct senders, rapid outflow of funds, and activity levels far exceeding a Student’s declared income are consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 549,000 was withdrawn as cash at an ATM in 2 transactions. PKR 440,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI)) in 2 transactions. Screening on 28 June 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse‑media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review on 11 June 2026, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
